scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Verify the customer's identity and confirm their account information before proceeding with the issue resolution.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Use phrases that acknowledge the customer's frustration and show understanding of their situation.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Repeat back the customer's problem in your own words to ensure understanding and show that you're actively listening.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Take responsibility for resolving the issue and avoid blaming other departments or the customer.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: Explicitly confirm that the issue has been resolved and ask the customer to verify the solution.
